areaNote: OSM way/301210399 (amenity=university, the main Huntington Avenue campus). relation/3905196, the first Nominatim hit, is only a few scattered parcels and left most academic buildings outside it.
noCodes: No public building-code list: the Office of the University Registrar's site has no building abbreviation key, class schedules give rooms by building name, and the campus map (northeastern.edu/campusmap, an ArcGIS Experience) labels buildings by name only (checked 2026-11-07).
